name: Kate
source:
Kate, the Keeper's niece, possesses a strange magical strength that lets her excel at physically demanding tasks with ease.

Yet, she remains delightfully feminine, fond of elegant dresses and graceful mannerisms. Above all, she loves pouring over tales of heroic adventurers and ancient lore.

[In game description]
